_about: Areas the in-depth backfill writes, one per run, in order. The workflow sets status to "done" after a run. Set it back to "todo" to have an area rewritten. Paths in sources are relative to the sxpanel repo root.

areas.title: Installation
areas.notes: Requirements, downloading the right archive (gen8 vs gen9), replacing the monitor folder, first start, finding the panel URL and PIN, ports, running on Windows and Linux.

areas.title: First-time setup and the server deployer
areas.notes: The setup wizard, using an existing server data folder vs deploying a recipe, every recipe in the picker, every wizard step and input, what the deployer writes. Take the first-time setup material out of configuration.mdx and link to this page instead.

areas.title: Migrating from txAdmin
areas.notes: What carries over (admins, bans, warns, players, settings), what does not, how to migrate step by step, how to go back. Move the migration section out of configuration.mdx and link here.

areas.title: Updating sxPanel and FXServer
areas.notes: System → Panel Update and System → Artifacts: update notices, patch vs feature updates, applying updates, rollback, recommended artifacts.

areas.title: Overview dashboard
areas.notes: Every dashboard card, server controls (start/stop/restart, announce, kick all, scheduled restarts), the performance chart and thread histogram, players sidebar, top bar (search, notifications, reconnect).

areas.title: Players and the player profile
areas.notes: Players page search modes, filters and columns, then the player profile modal tab by tab and every action in it (DM, warn, kick, ban, notes, identifiers, history, activity, spectate). Player tags are explained here; their settings page is linked.

areas.title: Whitelist
areas.notes: Every whitelist mode, the requests and approvals panels, forms, schedules, webhooks, and the Whitelist settings tab in full.

areas.title: Bans, warnings and history
areas.notes: History page search and filters, the action modal (edit, revoke, identifiers), ban durations, ban templates, adding legacy bans, ban appeals messaging, and the Bans settings tab in full.

areas.title: Reports and tickets
areas.notes: How players file reports in game, the ticket lifecycle, the Reports page and ticket detail modal, Report Analytics, Discord ticket handling, report settings.

areas.title: Live console
areas.notes: Sending commands, saved commands, search, filters, markers, download, options, buffer size, what needs Console: Write.

areas.title: Resources and resource config files
areas.notes: Resource list and grouping, start/stop/restart/ensure, downloading a resource, the config file editor (which files are editable, size limit, backups), and the in-game Resources page.

areas.title: Chat commands
areas.notes: Built-in commands (list every one with what it does and its permission), custom commands and every field in the editor, overriding and disabling built-ins. Move the Chat commands section out of features.mdx into this page and leave a short summary with a link.

areas.title: CFG editor
areas.notes: Editing server.cfg and included files, validation, saving and restarting, backups, what is blocked. Never show a real license key in examples.

areas.title: Server log and combat log
areas.notes: Every event type in the server log, filters, sessions, downloads, retention. Move the Combat logging section out of features.mdx into this page and leave a short summary with a link.

areas.title: Admins and permissions
areas.notes: A table of every permission (label, id, what it allows, flagged dangerous or not), presets, adding and editing admins, login methods, two-factor, password resets, the master admin, admin stats.

areas.title: Insights, player drops and analytics
areas.notes: Every Insights chart and how each number is calculated, time ranges, the Player Drops timeline and drill-down, data retention.

areas.title: System pages: logs, diagnostics and advanced
areas.notes: Action Log, Console Log, Diagnostics (including the diagnostics report and what it contains), and the Advanced page. Leave out development-only toggles.

areas.title: In-game menu
areas.notes: Opening the menu (command, keybind), every page and tab, every player action (heal, freeze, spectate, teleport, troll actions), NoClip/freecam controls, vehicle and world actions, map blips and player IDs, the Stats and Resources pages, warnings as seen by the player, and the menu and notification settings.

areas.title: Staff tools
areas.notes: Staff chat, the coordinates HUD, entity inspector, invisibility, cleanup, disarm and return, and their permissions.

areas.title: Settings overview, panel features and danger zone
areas.notes: Create the settings/ folder with its own meta.json. How the settings page works (tabs, saving per card, who can change settings), a table of all tabs linking to the page that documents each, then Panel Features, telemetry opt-out and Danger Zone in full.

areas.title: General and FXServer settings
areas.notes: Every field on the General and FXServer tabs, scheduled restarts, crash detection and auto-restart behaviour.

areas.title: Queue
areas.notes: How the connection queue works, priorities, every setting.

areas.title: Game settings and player tags
areas.notes: Every field on the Game and Player Tags tabs. Link to the in-game menu, reports and server log pages for the cards they own instead of repeating them.

areas.title: Appearance and custom themes
areas.notes: Light and dark mode, the theme studio, every token you can change, sharing and applying themes.

areas.title: Deferral cards
areas.notes: What deferral cards are, every scenario, the studio editor (elements, layout, images, buttons, preview), exporting, and how addons extend them.

areas.title: Discord bot setup and embeds
areas.notes: Creating the bot and inviting it, every Discord setting, the status and player list embeds and the embed editor, admin role sync and role-based permissions.

areas.title: Discord slash commands
areas.notes: Every slash command: options, who can run it, what it replies with, and the panel permission it maps to.

areas.title: Discord log routes
areas.notes: Every log route and what it sends, the routes editor, batching and rate limits.

areas.title: Host configuration, environment variables and convars
areas.notes: Every environment variable and convar with default and effect, ports and interfaces, reverse proxies and HTTPS, data folder layout, running several servers. Setup and migration material moves to their own pages.

areas.title: Events API and exports
areas.notes: Every event with its payload fields and when it fires, every export with parameters and return values, with Lua and JS examples.

areas.title: Installing and managing addons
areas.notes: Addon Manager in full: discovery, approval and re-approval, permission review, lifecycle controls, limits, where addon pages appear.

areas.title: Addon API
areas.notes: Every manifest field, every SDK method with signature and example, every addon permission. Check the existing page against the SDK typings and fill gaps.

areas.title: Introduction, features and troubleshooting
areas.notes: Last pass. Rewrite index.mdx and features.mdx as short overviews that link to every page written so far, and expand troubleshooting.mdx with the problems documented across the other pages, linking to each. Check every page is in meta.json in the right section.
